ops.text: `TestDiscoverTimeoutKillsDescendants` (internal/codeexec/discover_test.go:223) fails reproducibly under `go test -race ./...` on macOS but passes every time when its package runs alone (`go test -race ./internal/codeexec/`) or with `-run` scoped to it. Failure is `read grandchild PID: open .../grandchild.pid: no such file or directory` — under the parallel package load of a full-module run (internal/cli's race suite alone takes ~200s), the spawned grandchild doesn't write its pidfile before the test's timeout fires. It reads as a real regression during a release check and cost a couple of full-suite re-runs to rule out; CI is green because the runners are less loaded. The pidfile wait needs a poll-with-deadline instead of a single read.
